subject.title: fix(review): bind mutations to reviewed activity

question: Should trusted automation adopt this fail-closed review-activity cursor contract now, accepting that legacy verdicts pause and every mutation performs additional GitHub reads?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing the authorization freshness boundary and its operational availability cost is a repository policy decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Approve staged fail-closed rollout
options.body: Merge after the full gate passes, refresh legacy verdicts through normal reviews, monitor API pressure, and then land the dependent repair and proof PRs in order.

options.title: Add a compatibility window
options.body: Introduce a narrowly time-bounded migration path for legacy cursor-less verdicts, accepting temporary complexity and a weaker freshness boundary.

options.title: Pause the mutation-guard stack
options.body: Keep this PR and its dependents open until maintainers choose a broader transaction or lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Approve staged fail-closed rollout
recommendation.body: Merge after the full gate passes, refresh legacy verdicts through normal reviews, monitor API pressure, and then land the dependent repair and proof PRs in order.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision governs live repair and apply automation availability and authorization policy across the repository.
